subject: Isolated Edge Deployment: Capabilities & Evidence Package
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@edgehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@edgehealth.com>, procurement@edgehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Isolated Edge Deployment questionnaire (EdgeHealth RFP)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the product overview earlier this week. As part of our vendor evaluation for an on-prem/edge deployment, our security and procurement teams have a short technical questionnaire focused on isolated (air-gapped) edge sites and VPC connectivity patterns.

The ask: can you confirm support for the following and attach any architecture diagrams or evidence artifacts where available?
- Network/service dependencies during install (eg, outbound-only, one-way sync windows)
- KMS/HSM integration patterns for local key management
- Package signing & SBOM availability for offline updates
- Audit log retention when the control plane is offline
- Support matrix for RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu and minimum OS hardening levels

We need the answers and any supporting artifacts by EOD Tuesday (2027-08-10) to align with our internal scoring cadence. Please also include a point of contact for a short technical walkthrough.

Regards,
Alice
Alice Gomez
Head of IT Security
EdgeHealth
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Edge Deployment questionnaire (EdgeHealth RFP)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the list. We can cover each item; I’ve attached an evidence package and a brief network diagram that addresses your first three bullets. High level answers below and we can walk through details on a short call. Marcus will be the SRE lead on the walkthrough.

Quick answers (high level):
- Network during install: Installer supports fully offline installs. For managed control-plane scenarios we can operate with outbound-only whitelisting windows (certificate enrollment and image fetches). We provide a signed bundle for air-gapped import if customer prefers zero egress.
- KMS/HSM: Integrations supported via KMIP and customer-provided HSM; we also support local cloud KMS bridges for dedicated deployments. Keys can be generated and stored solely on-customer hardware.
- Package signing & SBOMs: All release artifacts are signed (detached signatures) and SBOMs are provided per-release; included in attachment.
- Audit logs: Agents buffer logs locally with configurable retention; when control plane is offline logs can be exported via secure transfer (sftp) or collected by on-prem SIEM. We include guidance for immutability options.
- OS matrix & hardening: We support RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04, and Rocky; recommended CIS benchmarks are listed in the checklist.

Attachments included: network diagram, airgap hardening checklist, evidence manifest (list of SBOMs and signatures).

Proposed walkthrough: tomorrow (2027-08-09) 10:00am PT — Marcus to lead and Priyom will cover procurement/terms questions. If that works, I’ll send an invite.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_edge_network-diagram.pdf (PDF, 372KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_airgap_hardening-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 95KB)]
[Attachment: evidence_manifest.json (JSON, 12KB)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@edgehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Edge Deployment questionnaire (EdgeHealth RFP)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the note. A couple of operational clarifications that may be material for scoring:

1) Installer model: we provide both an image-based offline installer (single bundle) and a gated pull model. For fully disconnected sites we recommend the image bundle; it contains the runtime, model artifacts (optional), and a local package registry.

2) Certificate enrollment: the enrollment can be manual (CSR import) or automated via a temporary egress window. For high-security sites customers commonly do CSR import and offline CA signing.

3) Log integrity: our agent supports forward-secure log signing and local write-once retention on configured storage; for environments that demand, we provide a workflow to export signed archives that your audit team can ingest.

4) Hardening and kernel tuning: recommended sysctl parameters and auditd rules are in the checklist; we recommend validating with your OS compliance team.

If helpful I can drop a short runbook excerpt into the drive link during the call.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@edgehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@edgehealth.com>, procurement@edgehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-09T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Edge Deployment questionnaire (EdgeHealth RFP)

Vanessa / Marcus —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the artifacts. Two follow-ups from the security team after a quick pass:
1) Can you confirm the SBOM format (CycloneDX / SPDX)? We need to consume SBOMs into our vulnerability tooling.
2) For the detached signatures you mentioned, are we able to provide our own PKI and verify signing locally without contacting Redwood again?

Also, we’ll take the 10:00am PT walkthrough — Tom and I will be on. Procurement is evaluating the terms but will send any gating language separately.

Thanks,
Alice
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Edge Deployment questionnaire (EdgeHealth RFP)

Hi Alice —

Short answers:
- SBOM format: We publish SBOMs in CycloneDX (JSON) and SPDX (tag-value) formats for every release; the evidence_manifest.json includes pointers and examples.
- Detached signatures & customer PKI: Yes — detached signatures are verifiable with customer keys. We support uploading your public root into our offline verification bundle or you can perform local verification using the provided sigtool. No external call-home required for verification.

We’ve also uploaded a short runbook excerpt and a sample verification command to the DocuSign/drive link included in the evidence package. If you want, we can provide a short scripted demo of an offline install during the call.

Thanks — see you at 10.
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
